_meta.purpose: Per-route travel flavor for the v26 narration overhaul. One entry per road segment leaving a city for the next battle city. `scene` is a key in sprites/story/backgrounds manifest `scenes`. The route interstitial shows `setOut` on departure; the city arrival bookend shows `arrive`. Mirrored by DEFAULT_ROUTE_LINES in battle.html (offline fallback).

city0to1.name: Route 1 · Breakwater Road
setOut: The last fence in Pallet was painted on the town side. You can feel the salt in the wood on this side.
A Pidgey hops along the wires ahead, one post at a time. It keeps stopping when you stop.
city0to1.terrain: Salt grass and split-rail fences above the beach.
city0to1.sightings: A Rattata drags an empty snack bag into the ditch.
arrive: Gravel replaces the grass. The mining siren goes off before you can see the first house.

city1to2.name: Mineshaft Pass
setOut: The road runs into the hillside at a gate barely wide enough for a cart. A miner asks you to leave it on the latch.
A cart rattles under the boards. Its lamp passes beneath your feet and goes on.
city1to2.terrain: Old mine rails under the boards. Timber braces overhead.
city1to2.sightings: Zubat stir between lamp hooks. A Geodude sits still enough to count as part of the wall.
arrive: Someone is soldering a kettle on the café step. She tells you to come in before your eyes get used to the light.

city2to3.name: Route 4 · Canopy Mile
setOut: Past the cafés, the path takes a half turn uphill into the trees.
A Caterpie is eating the trail marker from the end. There’s still a little black paint on its mouth.
city2to3.terrain: Tree roots have lifted two of the paving stones. The rest is moss.
city2to3.sightings: Caterpie cross the open trail. Something heavier takes the ridge above you.
arrive: The academy bell rings twice. Students run past holding their notebooks closed against the rain.

city3to4.name: Route 6 · Warden’s Track
setOut: The academy keeps its grounds dry. As soon as you leave them, you have to pull your foot out of the mud with both hands.
One pair of boot prints follows the fence to a gap in the wire. On the other side the grass has been flattened both ways.
city3to4.terrain: Flooded ruts and scrub, with long stretches of wire fence.
city3to4.sightings: Oddish fold their leaves around themselves. A Nidoran holds still until you look away.
arrive: A warden waits to tie the second knot in a red flag until you’re on her side of the gate.

city4to5.name: Lakeside Road
setOut: Outside Reedmarket you follow the water to where the planks start. The newer planks have dates stamped into them.
Someone has put a fee on fishing from the bank. The sign has a row of little teeth marks at the bottom.
city4to5.terrain: Reeds, rental boats and an old boardwalk under the lights.
city4to5.sightings: Magikarp slap the shallows. A Psyduck waits in the slot-machine glow.
arrive: The Gym raises its shutters to the sound of a slot bell. People have queued on both sides of the street.

city5to6.name: Route 9 · Switchback Road
setOut: From the first switchback you can see the resort’s lights reflected in the buckets the road crew left out.
A Machop lifts the last barrier to let you through. The worker behind it offers a lift down when you need one.
city5to6.terrain: Uphill highway shoulder with freight fences at the top.
city5to6.sightings: A Spearow hangs in the updraft. The road crew’s Machop knows to look both ways.
arrive: Someone is hosing down the square beyond the freight fence. You can still read the chalk through the water.

city6to7.name: Highcountry Pass
setOut: The pavement ends at a broken curb. Someone has set the missing piece across a washout, flat side up.
The wind fills your tracks with scree. At the ridge, an empty gate latch taps against the post.
city6to7.terrain: Bare ridge and loose scree over steep drops.
city6to7.sightings: You hear Onix before you see the stone move. A Skarmory passes overhead with one wing folded.
arrive: Three League portraits hang in the inn window. Someone has left a steaming bowl at Pokémon height on the step.

city7to8.name: Cathedral Approach
setOut: The road beyond the Champion’s town goes down before it goes up again. A hand rail takes you as far as the first arch.
Candle smoke comes through the passage. On the far side, a keeper is relighting every other candle.
city7to8.terrain: Vaulted rock opens onto the old chapel steps.
city7to8.sightings: Golbat hang above the lamps. A Misdreavus keeps to the space between them.
arrive: Light from the Lugia window falls across the Gym doors. A keeper sweeps spilled wax into a pan.

approachToLeague.name: Victory Road
setOut: The last sign gives the distance to the Plateau in someone’s handwriting. The first number has been rubbed out twice.
Above the next bend you can see trainers who will be out of sight by the time you reach it.
approachToLeague.terrain: Steep switchbacks between sealed doors. Scratches mark the places people waited.
approachToLeague.sightings: A shadow crosses the slope. The small Pokémon go still enough for you to see them.
arrive: The lights are buzzing over the registration desk. A clerk sees your badge case and lifts the chain.
